enchantments.tooltip: Wisdom +3: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +3 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Druidic Stoneshape: While in Wild Shape, you receive a Primal bonus to PRR equal to half the number of Wilderness Lore feats you have.
Insightful Constitution +1: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +1 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Magical Sheltering +8: +8 Enhancement bonus to Magical Resistance Rating
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
